resolution: Schema extensibility is unlimited; runtime fanout, depth, time and spend are bounded.

resolution: Retain permitted history; immediate access denial and tracked purge/withdrawal override retention aspirations.

conflict: Global knowledge versus private tenant strategy
resolution: Private data stays scoped; global patterns require rights and privacy-reviewed consent or public/licensed evidence.
Provide distinct local/client E2EE and server-assisted modes with truthful plaintext boundaries.
Provider-supported identity/resource/model grants are distinct; no fake universal Google inference grant.
One authority per aggregate; per-residency quorum grants fenced epochs; uncertain writes stop.
Votes are assigned role slots, not clone counts; independent outcomes and policy veto govern.
Agents may improve scoped capabilities, not rewrite constitutional policy or expand grants.
Snapshot maintenance remains labeled; production healing requires target telemetry, grants, tests and health receipts.
Capability envelope reports versioned authorized operations and actual evidence.
Use partitioned bounded queries, summaries and accessible neighborhoods, not all-node rendering.
Declare fidelity/calibration and unsupported questions; descriptor alone is not a calibrated twin.
Version gates and year horizons are separate axes; no automatic V10 at year10.
Durable lifecycle plus concurrent activity overlays; flattened status compatibility mapping explicit.
Reference contracts are design; D1 remains current until tested single-writer migration.
Logical contracts can co-deploy in a modular monolith; separate execution/isolation immediately and split by evidence.

Keep design/reference, stubbed route, live integration, isolation and production outcomes as separate evidence classes.

conflict: Every interaction improves versus noisy learning
resolution: Each authorized interaction may yield evidence; promotion requires regression/harm evaluation.

Link consumption to explicit additional paid jobs and apply model/worker costs to total workload; preserve old forecast version.

conflict: Account plan versus double-billed API usage
resolution: Display actual model billing path and charge only authorized separate platform resources; no silent fallback.

conflict: Immutable source versus new target baseline
resolution: Bind review/test to exact digests; stale target requires regeneration and renewed evidence.

resolution: Cancel future authority and reconcile receipts/compensations; never claim all effects undone.

Non-content global locator separate from per-residency write authority.

conflict: Declared no increase in heuristics versus behavioral correctness
resolution: Static heuristic checks do not satisfy application tests; evidence requirements vary by action class.

resolution: End-customer targets define an illustrative scenario; independent funnel/capacity forecast must validate demand.

conflict: Learning qualification versus Active-only activity contract
resolution: The default learning pattern uses an Active independent evaluator on a Learning candidate that cannot claim production tasks. Generate lifecycle table/diagram/API from the same transition registry.

conflict: Global publication policy versus weak propagation helper
resolution: Reference helper is illustrative, not production authorization. Require signed publication receipt, current object access, destination scope/purpose, withdrawal generation and receiving-side admission even within one tenant.
Credits advise allocation priority within already authorized/reserved money; they cannot create, enlarge or transfer monetary entitlement or permission.

resolution: Expected monthly jobs are utilization hypotheses; production entitlements use immutable quantity/money tariffs with explicit provider billing path, overage consent and reserved ceilings.
